title: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.19871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. translated_title: 面向大语言模型智能体推理的交互式结构化环境扩展
translated_abstract: 通过环境交互进行强化学习是将大语言模型演进为能够进行多轮工具使用和探索的自主智能体的基石性后训练范式。由于环境定义了策略所观察到的内容以及动作如何被验证，环境的结构直接限制了智能体所能获得的能力上限。然而，现有的结构化和检索环境依赖于上游预过滤——即在策略行动之前围绕标准答案提取紧凑子图或检索固定段落。我们证明这种预过滤引入了一个根本性的测量混淆问题：由于每个问题对应的子图包含了真实路径，它们将候选空间压缩了几个数量级，并通过局部拓扑结构泄露了答案位置，使得一个与问题无关的度数启发式方法能够以远高于随机水平的概率找到标准答案。为了将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止恢复为真正的策略决策……
tldr: 本文揭示了现有结构化环境中预过滤机制会泄露答案位置、导致能力评估失真的问题，并提出交互式结构化环境扩展方法，将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止还原为智能体真正的策略决策。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that upstream pre-filtering in existing structured environments compresses the candidate space and leaks answer locations, and proposes interactive structured environment scaling to restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions for LLM agentic reasoning.
